title: Dockhand before 1.0.57 merges stack secret environment variables into the environment used to spawn docker compose…
description: Dockhand versions before 1.0.57 have a vulnerability where stack secret environment variables are merged into the environment used to spawn docker compose during stack deployments without filtering reserved keys like PATH. An authenticated attacker with stacks:edit permission can exploit this by setting PATH to a directory with a malicious binary, causing arbitrary command execution as the Dockhand server process user during deployment.
